about: Bismarck-Mandan and New Salem local (non-chain) research, compiled 9-10 Nov 2026 for the Veterans Day 2026 planner. Only the ND Heritage Center program (KX, 4 Nov) is announced for Wednesday with a time. AMVETS, VFW, the New Salem Legion and the Memorial globe tradition are earlier-years-only: call first. National chains are handled elsewhere. KX News pages are behind a bot check; where noted, 2026 KX details came from the one page I could read or from search summaries.

other.name: New Salem: John Repsdorf American Legion Post 91 Veterans Day program
other.where: Post 91, 400 Main Ave, New Salem (call 701-587-1215 or email ndpost91@gmail.com for the time and place)
other.offer: In past years a Veterans Day program for veterans and families, public invited, with lunch served (held at Elm Crest Manor). Nothing posted for 2026.
other.note: Not on the route because no 2026 time is published. Call before you plan around it.

sources.publisher: American Legion Dept. of ND post histories

other.day: Thu 12 Nov, three seatings (times not found)
other.name: 16th Annual Veterans Feed (free turkey dinner)
other.where: Bismarck/Mandan Elks Lodge #1199, 900 S Washington St, Bismarck, ND 58504 (lodge 701-255-1199)
other.offer: Free turkey dinner with all the trimmings for veterans and first responders, three dining time slots, tickets reported still available as of KX's Nov 3 2026 story.
other.note: KX News (3 Nov 2026) reported the 16th annual feed on Thu 12 Nov with three seatings and tickets still available; its times and ticket rules weren't readable here. In earlier years it ran 10:30 AM to 1:30 PM, free for a veteran and one guest, with proof of service and tickets from sponsor businesses. The Elks' own calendar doesn't list it. Call the lodge, (701) 255-1199.

sources.publisher: ND Dept of Veterans Affairs (2022 notice)

other.name: ND state park lifetime pass for disabled veterans and former POWs
other.where: ND Parks & Recreation (apply by form; parkrec@nd.gov)
other.offer: Free lifetime pass for ND veterans with a 50 percent or greater service-connected disability and former POWs; other ND veterans with a service-related disability may buy an annual permit for $28.
other.note: Needs a current VA Summary of Benefits Letter (disability) or a DD-214 (former POWs). ND Parks' permit page says 'ND veterans'; whether non-residents qualify isn't stated there. No Veterans Day free-entry offer on the Parks site. Fort Abraham Lincoln still needs a vehicle permit.

other.name: Theodore Roosevelt National Park: no entrance fee on Veterans Day
other.where: South Unit, Medora, ND (park 701-623-4466); about 130 miles and 2 hours west of Bismarck on I-94; Mountain time at Medora
other.offer: NPS lists Nov 11 as a 2026 fee-free day. Free entrance is for US citizens and residents only. Normally $30 per vehicle for 7 days.
other.note: Drive claim checked: Medora's tourism site says about 130 miles and about 2 hours. Medora is on Mountain time, so the clock goes back one hour driving west. Round trip is a 4+ hour day in mid-November; check 511 and park road conditions. The fee page says the park has been cashless since 1 May 2026 (page itself says last updated 2024, so verify). Veterans may also get a free Military Lifetime Pass.

sources.publisher: National Park Service, Theodore Roosevelt NP

other.name: ND Heritage Center & State Museum: open or closed on Veterans Day
other.offer: Admission is always free. The museum's FAQ and hours pages list closures as New Year's Day, Easter, Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve and Christmas Day; Veterans Day is not listed. The Groups page says only 'The facility is closed on state holidays.' Archives and offices close on state holidays.
other.note: The museum's own hours and FAQ pages don't list Veterans Day as a closure, and the 9:45 AM program is in the building that morning. Whether the galleries are open all day isn't confirmed; state offices are closed. Call (701) 328-2666.

other.name: Bis-Man Transit / Capital Area Transit (CAT): veterans fare
other.offer: No free rides for veterans found, on Veterans Day or always. The fare page lists a reduced fare for 'Veterans with appropriate photo ID': $0.75 each way (regular $1.50), $3 day pass, $24 30-day pass. Seniors 65+ and paratransit ride free.
other.note: CAT's fare page (dated 15 Jan 2017) lists a half-price fare for veterans with photo ID, so amounts may have changed. A 2015 notice said buses run on Veterans Day with the office closed; no 2026 holiday schedule was found. Call (701) 258-6817.

other.name: Closures on Veterans Day
other.offer: Bismarck Parks & Recreation administrative office is closed 11 Nov; other Parks facilities keep normal hours.
other.note: The Parks item is from the Parks district's Veterans Day hours page. State offices, federal offices and post offices also close on 11 Nov (federal holiday); check before a trip that needs one.
